info.title: Ax ↔ Habitat Gateway
info.description: Read status, mission results and heartbeat events; submit missions, decide approvals with an owner attestation, and run bounded recovery. Disabled unless HABITAT_GATEWAY_ENABLED=true. Every POST requires x-ax-timestamp and x-ax-nonce. A 202 means received, not executed; a completed mission is verified only when its detail reports verification evidence.

servers.description: Set this to the public HTTPS origin of the Habitat gateway before importing into ChatGPT.

bearerAuth.description: Dedicated integration token, shown once, stored hashed, revocable.

workerCredential.name: x-ax-worker-credential
workerCredential.description: axw_<credentialId>_<secret>. Each request is HMAC-signed over worker, credential, operation, nonce, timestamp and body hash, and carries a single-use nonce.

nonce.name: x-ax-nonce
nonce.description: 16-128 chars, single use within the timestamp window.

workerSignature.name: x-ax-signature
workerSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical worker statement, base64url, prefixed v1,

ownerAttestation.name: attestation
ownerAttestation.description: Owner HMAC over the exact workforce statement being mutated.

idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotency.description: Same key returns the same mission; duplicate:true.

get.summary: Habitat status (identity, workforce, missions, storage, heartbeat)

post.summary: Approve or reject a pending mission (owner attestation required)

taskId.description: Names the one task approval this decision authorises; omit to answer only the mission-scope signal.

get.summary: Reconnect trigger with current status, missions, pending work and queued events

post.summary: Bounded mission recovery (never approves or deploys)

List worker identities with derived health

post.summary: Owner-attested registration or update of a worker identity and its capability declaration

get.summary: Worker detail with health, active assignments and lease history

post.summary: Owner-attested deregistration; revokes every worker credential and is refused while a live lease exists unless force is set
Signed worker heartbeat; the path id must equal the credential's worker, and every nonce works once

get.summary: Active leases: which worker owns which mission task, and until when
Recovery history: expiries, reassignments, resumes, uncertain outcomes
Mission-to-worker relationships, attempts and lease history
Failed missions and stalled missions, with the workers attached to each
Credential metadata for a worker (never the secret)

post.summary: Owner-attested credential issue; the secret is returned once and never again
Owner-attested rotation: same durable worker identity, new key, old key usable only during the grace window
Signed worker lease acquisition; identity comes from the credential, never the body
Signed renewal; only the credential that owns the lease can renew it
Signed release; only the owning credential can release

get.summary: Attempts whose external outcome is unknown, with provider references
Read-only inspection of one uncertain attempt and its provider reference

post.summary: Owner-attested verdict: confirmed_success, confirmed_failure, not_executed (proof required to allow a retry) or unknown

proof.description: Provider evidence; required unless the verdict is unknown.

Reassignment and recovery decisions: from worker, to worker, reason and decision
